description: This file contains functions related to converting object hashes and objects (commit, tree, tag) between different hash algorithms in a Git repository context. It includes functions for mapping object IDs, decoding tree entries, and converting full objects between hash algorithms.

methods.name: int repo_oid_to_algop(struct repository * repo,const struct object_id * src,const struct git_hash_algo * to,struct object_id * dest)
methods.description: Converts a repository object ID to a different hash algorithm, possibly reloading the object map if needed.

methods.name: int decode_tree_entry_raw(struct object_id * oid,const char ** path,size_t * len,const struct git_hash_algo * algo,const char * buf,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Decodes a raw tree entry to extract the object ID and file path.

methods.name: int convert_tree_object(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * out,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const char * buffer,size_t size)
methods.description: Converts a tree object buffer from one hash algorithm to another, updating object IDs within.

methods.name: int convert_tag_object(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * out,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const char * buffer,size_t size)
methods.description: Converts a tag object buffer between hash algorithms, updating the object ID and signatures.

methods.name: int convert_commit_object(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * out,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const char * buffer,size_t size)
methods.description: Converts a commit object buffer between hash algorithms, updating referenced tree, parent, and mergetag objects.

methods.name: int convert_object_file(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * outbuf,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const void * buf,size_t len,enum object_type type,int gentle)
methods.description: Main entry point to convert an object file (blob, tree, commit, tag) between hash algorithms.
